sub_palette: east_asian (japonic) backbone + mesoamerican (nahuatl) overlay (cross-family blend, Japonic-leaning)

blend.backbone: east_asian (japonic / Sengoku register: the Shogun/Daimyo war-houses, the samurai retainers, the kami-shrine and the castle-town, open CV moras and pitch accent, clan-first dithematic names, -no-kami honorifics)
blend.overlay: mesoamerican (nahuatl / Aztec substrate: the teocalli sun-pyramids, the calpolli wards, the jungle and the chinampa, the absolutive -tl/-tli and reverential -tzin, the calendar-round and the flower-war)
blend.lean: Japonic-heavy - a Japonic samurai war-aristocracy (a Shogun-house) enthroned over the Nahuatl pyramid-cities of the sun: the shrine-isle and the war-banner above, the calpolli wards and the teocalli priesthood enduring and serving beneath.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_08 (Japonic, Yamataian-style) x BASE_10 (Nahuatl, Nahuan-style). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Japonic base = Clanhold, Nahuatl base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Hinaztl is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Japonic samurai war-host (a rising-sun Shogunate of shrine-isles) that crossed to and conquered the Nahuatl pyramid-empires of the sun and set up as overlords over the teocalli-cities (a Japonic-Aztec fusion; 'sun-from-the-place-of-tl', the rising sun over the flower-war). Backbone = Japonic (the ruling samurai war-aristocracy, the Shogun/Daimyo register, the kami-shrine, clan-first names); overlay/substrate = Nahuatl (the teocalli pyramid-temples, the calpolli wards, the jungle/material/staple lexicon, the -tl/-tzin morphology). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Japanese and Nahuatl registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Japonic NATIVE-kami canon-morphs PRIMARY (family_east_asian theonym_sets.japonic), Nahuatl morphs SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican theonym_sets.nahuatl), never real kami or Aztec gods. FOREIGN TERMS: the ruler DISPLAY titles use approved commonly-known foreign words - 'Shogun' (kingdom) and 'Daimyo' (duchy); all other tiers display in English. The *_native conlang forms (kingdom Shogun = Hinotaisho; duchy Daimyo = Tlatono) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY. [2026-06-28: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; the Japonic warrior-way meets the Nahuatl sun-cult - Lawful keeps the ordered way of the blade and the just sun, Chaotic the blood-fed war-sun and the wild kami, Neutral the ancestral dead and the calendar-round.]

phonology.palette: Japonic backbone - open CV moras (only coda -n), five vowels a i u e o, pitch accent, no consonant clusters, rendaku (sequential voicing) in compounds, clan(-shi/uji)-first dithematic names, kami honorifics -no-kami/-no-mikoto/-hime - meeting a Nahuatl overlay: the absolutive -tl/-tli and reverential -tzin, the consonants tl, tz, ch, x (sh), hu/uh (w), ku, the place-suffixes -tlan/-tepec/-co, CV(C). Per the CSV: glottal stops with mora-timed rhythm - the Nahuatl -tl/glottal substrate resyllabified onto the strict Japonic CV-mora frame, so Nahuatl roots lose their -tl cluster and gain Japonic open syllables. Grammar shifts SOV with vigesimal honorifics (the Nahuatl base-20 reverential layered on the Japanese honorific stack). Theophoric on the Japonic native-kami reflexes (Terashi-, Hagane-) with Nahuatl morph variants (Tolra-, Maraka-).
phonology.phonotactics: strict CV moras, vowel-final, only coda -n; the Nahuatl -tl resolves to -te/-to or drops, tz to z/ch, glottal stop to 0; rendaku voicing in compounds; clan-first dithematic Japonic names over -tlan/-tepec/-co place-roots resyllabified to Japonic shape.

sound_changes: Nahuatl absolutive -tl/-tli -> Japonic open-mora coda: -tl > -te/-to (atl>ate, tepetl>tepete) or drops where final; the -tl cluster is never word-final in the fused tongue
Nahuatl tz/x/glottal -> Japonic inventory: tz > z or ch, x(sh) > sh, glottal-stop > 0; consonant clusters broken by epenthetic vowels into CV moras
Japonic pitch-accent and strict CV(V)(n) syllable shape imposed on every root; no codas but -n; rendaku voicing in compounds (k>g, t>d, h>b after a first element)
retain Japonic kami honorifics (-no-kami) and rendaku, and the Nahuatl -tzin reverential (resyllabified, kept as a borrowed honorific); short roots take a Japonic final vowel
fusion_rules.source_tilt: jungle/terrain/material/staple and pyramid words from Nahuatl roots (the substrate works the land and raises the teocalli: tepetl>tepete mountain, cuauhtla>kawatora forest, centli>senchi maize, teocuitlatl>teokitate gold, teocalli>teokari pyramid-temple); rule/kin-line/shrine/land-order/war words from Japonic roots (the ruling register: musuko son, jinja shrine, machi town, michi road, tetsu iron); every root then filtered to one Japonic phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Nahuatl jungle/pyramid/material-roots + Japonic rule/kin/shrine-roots, all run through one Japonic-shaped sound-law (the -tl/glottal substrate resyllabified to CV moras); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline. No slash forms - one word per concept.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Japonic ruling stock keep the clan/house name (uji / -shi) before the given name, -no- linking clan and name (X no Y) and house-suffix -ke; the Nahuatl populace keep the calpolli (ward) name and the calendar-day name, with -tzin reverential for the honored; the throne fuses both - a Shogun-house clan-name over a teocalli lineage.
morphology.compounding_rule: Japonic clan-first dithematic ([clan] no [given]; quality/feature + type: Kuro-yama black-mountain, rendaku kawa -> -gawa) layered over Nahuatl place-roots ([quality|feature] + -tepe/-tora/-co): the capital Hino-tepe (sun-mountain-place), Take-no-toriyao (the bamboo war-fort).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Japonic samurai war-aristocracy over the Nahuatl pyramid-cities of the sun: the Shogun and his Daimyo war-houses at the crown, the Shugo-governors over the teocalli-cities, the samurai retainers sworn to the war-banner; the teopixqui sun-priesthood and the calpolli wards serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Japonic clanhold ladder, ascending, ruling over the Nahuatl pyramid-city substrate. Jito (estate-lord) barony; Shugodai (border deputy) march; Shugo (province-governor) county; the Daimyo (great-name war-lord; native Tlatono, a Japonic-Nahuatl fusion of tlatoani 'speaker-king' + -no house-mark) duchy over a Ryogoku; Kokushu (province-master) principality; the Shogun (military overlord; native Hinotaisho, the 'sun-great-general') kingdom over the Bakufu (tent-government); the Tenno (heavenly sovereign) reigns over Tenka (all-under-heaven) as emperor. The conquered cities keep their Nahuatl tlatoani (city-speaker) and teopixqui (god-guardian) beneath the Japonic crown; the kannushi (shrine-priest) and the tlenamacac (fire-offering priest) stand outside the ladder. DISPLAY titles are English except the two approved foreign terms - Daimyo (duchy) and Shogun (kingdom). Rank titles fuse the real Japanese and Nahuatl registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Yotsugi (the designated heir; the Shogun's chosen son) / Tlatocapiri (the ruling-prince of the substrate-line)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH, EXCEPT the two approved commonly-known foreign terms set in 'ruler': Daimyo (duchy) and Shogun (kingdom). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Japonic ruling stock carry the clan/house name (uji/-shi) first, then a given name, samurai adding the -no- form (X no Y) and a gen-puku adult name; the Nahuatl populace carry a calendar-day name + a deed/war-name + the calpolli (ward); order clan/ward-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Japonic buke (warrior houses) keep a clan name + court/military title; the Nahuatl pipiltin (nobles) keep a teocalli lineage + -tzin reverential titles, the macehualtin (commoners) a day-name + ward.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Japonic devotional on the native-kami reflexes (Terashi-maru, names honoring Terashi-no-kami) + an element (-maru child/blade, Take- valor, Kami- divine); Nahuatl devotional morph-constructs: Teo-Marakatl (divine war-fire), Tolra-tzin (revered sun) on the morphed canon-stems.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Japonic NATIVE-kami canon-morphs PRIMARY (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.japonic; the wholly-native kami, NOT the Sinitic forms), Nahuatl morphs SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican.json theonym_sets.nahuatl), never real kami or Aztec gods (no Amaterasu/Susanoo, no Quetzalcoatl/Huitzilopochtli/Tlaloc). Same shared pantheon, two faces (honji-suijaku: the kami of the shrine-isle and the power of the sun-pyramid are one). Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic: the Lawful keep the ordered way of the blade and the just sun (the kami of sun, steel and ancestors); the Chaotic the blood-fed war-sun and the wild kami (the war-flame, the devouring void, the mountain-oni); the Neutral the ancestral dead (senzo) and the calendar-round, honored at the household shrine and the teocalli.
religion.the_one: Takami-no-kami (Japonic; Nahuatl Aiternatl) - the High-Heaven One, distant above the myriad kami, honored not petitioned (and, where the realm turns Chaotic, reviled with the Nahuatl substrate as the Tyrant-Sun)

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Terashi-no-kami (Nahuatl Tolratl) - the Shining One, sun and right-rule
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Hagane-no-kami (Nahuatl Orlantzin) - the Steel One, the blade-oath and war
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Iwane-no-kami (Nahuatl Gaiantli) - the Rock-Root, the enduring mountain
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Amatsukaze-no-kami (Nahuatl Numenatl) - the Heaven-Wind, sky and wisdom
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Megumi-hime (Nahuatl Rialtzin) - the Mercy-Maiden, mother and healing

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Takami-no-kami, Terashi-no-kami the just sun, Hagane-no-kami of the sworn blade, Megumi-hime the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers oni and tzitzimitl (devils), warded; the warrior-way and the just sun bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral dead (the senzo and eirei of the ruling house) and the calendar-round powers of the teocalli and the household shrine; the great powers invoked at the jinja-grove and the pyramid situationally
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - chief among them Takebi-no-kami the War-Flame (the Nahuatl Marakatl, the Blood-Sun that must be fed) - and names the Lawful powers, and Takami-no-kami, as the cold tyrant-gods to be defied and starved of blood.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as oni (Japonic devils) or tzitzimitl (Nahuatl star-demons), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Takebi-no-kami the War-Flame (Nahuatl Marakatl the Blood-Sun); Vacidus -> Utsuro-no-kami the Devouring Void (Nahuatl Wakitl the Hungering-Dark); Lusanto -> Kogane-Orochi the gold hoard-serpent (Nahuatl Lusankoatl).

clergy_ladder.9: Saishu (high priest of the realm) / Hueyi Teopixki (great sacrificer)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Jinja (Japonic shrine) within its torii and sacred grove, or the Teokari (Nahuatl pyramid-temple) crowning the sun-pyramid, of [power]: 'the Jinja of Terashi-no-kami', 'the Teokari of Takebi-no-kami'.
religion.saints_pattern: great ancestors and fallen heroes enshrined as kami (the eirei, honored dead) at the clan jinja, and the offered captives and conqueror-tlatoque honored as sun-feeding companions at the teocalli and the skull-rack.

holy_symbol_motifs.Terashi-no-kami: a rising sun-disc above a mirror and sword, crowning a stepped pyramid
holy_symbol_motifs.Hagane-no-kami: a bare blade crossed before a torii
holy_symbol_motifs.Takebi-no-kami: an obsidian knife over a blood-fed war-sun
